answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own vertex record, and its own share of the timber quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The lantern ledger enforces the limit at intake. The nonce chain allows at most 3 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 3479 identities would post 3132 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
